Author: @wmbtech
Content:
You know what. I'm glad there's a social wall between the science channels and the cooking channels I watch. 😂😂😂

This type of cooking is conduction heating, the most time dependant form of heating, because it's the heat transfer from one solid to another through contact. The solidified, but still hot, lava around the chicken only makes contact with the surface, much like a hot skillet, and the extra heat either carbonizes the surface, radiates off the lava itself, or both. It's intuitive thinking about it like a hot pan, since most cooks know you can't use high heat to speed up cooking through large food items.
